verdict.rationale: Proactive alerting is a fair axis for an FP&A platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents notifications for variance against plan or for approaching reporting deadlines. The materials describe live actuals, auto-updating narratives and decks, and on-demand answers, which are adjacent features rather than proactive alerts.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform notifies me when a metric moves against plan or a reporting deadline approaches, before I ask
